about: The customisation build's option table (since 2026-11-07a, C1): the one list of slots, options, badges, palette rows and faction sets, read by Program.cs (the records), look_paint.py (the palette and paint BGSMs), look_badges.py and look_render.py (the badge art and the contact sheets) and the checks. Save-stable: options keep their index and their records' IDs; later builds only append (at a list's end, IDs after 0xA13). Every slot's option 0 is the 2026-11-06a look (a slot's `default` is the index the game starts on: the right tank's 17 follows the left). Material paths are relative to Data\Materials, texture paths to Data\Textures. `swap` is the option's MSWP entries [source, target] (target = source: the identity, which puts a loaded 3D back); `follow` has no MSWP. `ids` = [MSWP, OMOD, COBJ] in CommonwealthMotorbike.esp (light; runtime FExxx + the low 12 bits). `cost` lists [component EditorID, count] (FormIDs in `components`); `perk` an EditorID of `perks`; `loose` the loose mod's MISC EditorID. Mirrors: `mirror` is CMB_LookCode's bits 0-1 (0 none, 1 stock, 2 egg, 3 D); the parked bike's swap only, the plugin does the worn and first-person bikes. Paint: `row` is the palette row of Textures\CMB\Bike\paint_p.dds (256 x 64, one mip; BGSM grayscale_to_palette_scale (row + 0.5) / 64); colours a (the tank), b (the fenders), c (the coachline) are sRGB hex. `right_mirrored` (measured in step 0 on the shipped static_badge with bike_pieces.badge_uvs: the sign of (dP/du x dP/dv) . the outward normal is the same on both tank plates and the roundel, u running to the viewer's right and v down): false, both plates read true from outside, so the right slot targets the same badge_<key>.bgsm as the left.

about_c2: Since 2026-11-08a (C2: rims and tyres, the paint's hue slider, the licence plates; SP t53 plan 1). Every C2 entry carries "since": "2026-11-08a" (the 6 slots Rims, Tyres, Plate, PlateText, PlateInk, PlateBack appended as slots 5-10, Paint's option 45, paint row 43, the globals): the generator's `--look-build 2026-11-07a` (and step 0's filter) drops them and makes 2026-11-07a's ESP byte for byte. C2's records are a second block after C1's lists, IDs 0x000A14-0x000BF0 (477, contiguous), made in this order: fixed_globals (0xA14-0xA17, CMB_Slope.dll finds them by ID), script_globals (0xA18-0xA1A), the 6 slot globals (each slot's global_id, 0xA1B-0xA20), the 6 attach points (ap_id, 0xA21-0xA26), Paint 45 (0xA27-0xA29), every C2 slot's options in table order (ids [MSWP, OMOD, COBJ]; `follow` and `colour` options have no MSWP: [null, OMOD, COBJ]), the 6 option lists (list_id 0xBE7-0xBEC), the 4 swap lists (swaps_id 0xBED-0xBF0; the colour slots none). New kinds: `hue` (Paint 45: its BGSMs read paint_hue_p.dds, V from CMB_LookHue and CMB_LookShade), `rim` (rim_style 0 cast or 1-7, finish a rim_finishes key), `tyre` (band), `design` (design 1-12 of plates), `text` (text, crude), `colour` (colour 0-15 of plate_colours or null = the plate's own; an OMOD and a COBJ, no properties, no swap); `follow` is PlateText 0 (the design's own text, plates[].own_text). A crude text's COBJ has the condition GetGlobalValue CMB_LookPlateCrude == 1. V (a palette row's centre, an MSWP entry's colorIndex, a fixed global's value): Paint 45 (shade x 256 + round(hue x 255 / 359) + 0.5) / 1024; a body-colour rim the paint's row (paint_row_of_option: (row + 0.5) / 64) or, with Paint 45, the hue's V on its `bodyhue` twin (rim_body_targets); the plate ((design - 1) x 16 + background + 0.5) / 256; its text (ink + 0.5) / 16; -1 = don't write. Stock (option 0 of every slot) is the 2026-11-07a look. Rim sources: the cast rim's 4, then per style its 4 (wheelF_rim<Style>, its _worn, wheelR_rim<Style>, its _worn; each style's own materials file is invisible); a cast finish swaps the cast sources to castF_<f>/castR_<f>, a style's option the cast sources to off.bgsm and that style's to rimF_<f>/rimR_<f> (one shared rim atlas, so a finish's target is one per wheel). Sets' `plate`: the Plate index a faction set fits (null: unchanged; a set also puts PlateText, PlateInk and PlateBack to 0).

fixed_globals.what: the Free colour paint's V (paint_hue_p.dds), for the worn bike's static_paint and fork_paint
a body-colour rim's V (paint_p.dds's row, or paint_hue_p.dds's with Free colour), for the shown rim of either wheel
V(design, background) of plate_p.dds, for static_plate

script_globals.what: MCM "Paint hue" (slider 0-359): the Free colour paint's hue (Paint 45)
MCM "Paint shade" (stepper 0-3: Deep, Normal, Light, Pastel)
MCM "Crude plate texts" (switcher): 0 hides the 14 crude PlateText recipes (their COBJ condition GetGlobalValue CMB_LookPlateCrude == 1) and Compose shows the plate's own text instead
